cross_validated_refitted_readout.interpretation: difference from fixed-readout substitution can reflect readout recalibration and does not itself identify a causal code
cross_validated_refitted_readout.method: five-fold orbit-grouped L2 logistic regression with C=1; post hoc supervised comparator
